description_for_human: Phase 0 test tools (route A). Records nothing.
description_for_model: Phase 0 platform test tools served by the Spaarke MCP spike on the legal-operations route. Use only when the user explicitly asks to call a spike tool.

functions.name: spike_echo
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 platform tests only; echoes the message back. Not for: any real work.

functions.name: spike_echo_3mb
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 widget-size test only; echoes the message back and renders a ~3 MB widget. Not for: any real work.

functions.name: spike_echo_6mb
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 widget-size test only; echoes the message back and renders a ~6 MB widget. Not for: any real work.

functions.name: spike_write
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 test T4 only (a model-callable tool that is not read-only). This is a Phase 0 test tool that records nothing: it writes no data anywhere and only returns what it would have written. Not for: any real work.

functions.name: spike_unannotated
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 test T12 only; echoes the message back from a tool that declares no annotations. Not for: any real work.

functions.name: spike_whoami
functions.description: Use for: Phase 0 auth test T5 only; returns the caller's Dataverse systemuserid (on-behalf-of) and which token claims are present. Not for: any real work.
